findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 467 requests to 117 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 8.1 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 6.1 MB (76%) came from third-party domains, 2.5 MB of it from services classified as tracking (322 requests).

67 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), acuityplatform.com (Acuity Ads, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising).
234 cookies were set by third-party domains (278 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Content-Security-Policy header or meta tag.
